body:
READ-ONLY reweigh of superseding tip 6562c88. B5 CLOSED on the compiler path: the output retains Evidence, base Provenance, and full emitted ClaimMeta; accepted context upstream closure and gap ById resolution survive input disposal; construction checks the relevant dangling references. B6 CLOSED: provider-only causal/context/membership are Hypothesized and the causal pin is direct. Original M1 call-order case CLOSED: base and per-claim calls use one canonical rendering order. The new full-ClaimMeta fingerprint and hidden-status mutation pin are correct.

ONE REMAINING CONTENT-ADDRESS BLOCKER: the canonical renderer still aliases distinct legal optional values. renderProviderCall uses call.promptTemplateVersion.getOrElse("") (:1480-1496), so ProviderCall(..., promptTemplateVersion=None, ...) and the structurally unequal ProviderCall(..., promptTemplateVersion=Some(""), ...) render identically. ProviderCall is a public case class and NarrativeCompilerInput.of neither rejects nor canonicalizes blank prompt versions. The collision survives both candidateSet and the new renderClaimMeta -> renderProvenance path because both reuse renderProviderCall. Therefore two compilations can retain unequal provenance/resolution records yet receive the same fingerprint — the exact equality/fingerprint disagreement M1 was meant to close. CriticFinding.note has the same None/Some("") shape at :1450-1464.

Narrow repair: either (a) reject/canonicalize blank optional strings at input construction so None is the sole empty representation, or (b) length-frame an explicit option tag (none vs some) in the renderers. Add an adversarial replay pin using otherwise-identical calls with None vs Some(""): if blank is invalid/canonical, construction/equality must say so; if distinct, fingerprints must differ. Reassess all getOrElse("")/fold("") fields once, but validated nonblank fields need no widening. No edits; no gate verdict.
